title: DP-350F / DGP-350F - Deesys 3-Phase Voltage Transformer, 1150 V, 50 VA
range_short_desc: Three-phase voltage transformer for switchgear metering
description: Deesys three-phase measuring voltage transformer in one body, rated up to 1150 V, accuracy class 1.0 %, burden 50 VA. DP-350F covers 3P3W circuits (primary 220–600 V, secondary 110–220 V); DGP-350F covers 3P4W circuits (primary 208/√3–440/√3 V, secondary 190/√3 V). Simplifies switchgear wiring compared with separate single-phase PTs.

feature_groups.title: Main Feature
items: Three-phase measuring PT in one compact body — easy to install
Less expensive and more economical to apply to switchgear
